root_text:
#WashYourHands thoroughly for 40-60 seconds especially after:

🤧Coughing/sneezing
😷Caring for the sick
🚽Using the toilet
🐕Handling animals or their waste
👩🏼‍🍳When preparing food #FoodSafety
🍴Before eating
✋🏼When your hands are dirty
#HMPV #
